shell_command_template_deprecation.description:
The `command_line` `{platform}` `{name}` runs a command (`{program}`) that uses a template together with shell features (pipes, redirects, globbing, etc.). For security, templated commands will stop being run through a shell in Home Assistant 2027.4 and these shell features will no longer work.

Update the command to avoid shell features in the templated part, or move the logic into a script the command calls.
shell_command_template_deprecation.title: Command with a template uses shell features
